name: annotation_is_taken_away
why: REPORT 8CD843 N24, round 7 (27/10/2026). Three wrong dimensions put on a copy of the clip drawing could not be taken away: «undo» had no plan to withdraw (a plan on a drawing records no undo entry it can take back) and proposed delete_feature, which does not touch an annotation. They stayed on the drawing. «delete_annotation» takes one away by the name the plan that placed it gave.
defect_caught: An operation that answers «removed» while the dimension is still on the sheet, or that takes away another one. The case asks for the count before and after (two, then one) and for the name of what went: RD1, the first dimension placed. «removed» alone would be the answer of whoever did the thing, not the measure of the thing.
